security.csp: default-src 'self'; img-src * data: blob:; media-src * blob:; connect-src * ipc: http://ipc.localhost; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; font-src 'self' data:; worker-src blob:

bundle.shortDescription: A fast, light IPTV player with cloud recording.
bundle.longDescription: Vesper is a lightweight IPTV player with live TV, a timeline guide, movies, series, catch-up and recording. Connect it to a Vesper Cloud server to record in the cloud and keep your library in sync on every device.
